fact_notes: Source for all lines: jusrecruit.com home, /about, /ai-phone-screening, /ai-interviews, /pricing, read 2026-11-20.

L1-3: home page problem section: 'Your ATS Tracks the Work. Your Recruiters Still Do It'; 'Too Many Applications'; 'First-Round Screening Takes Hours'. 'Hundreds of applicants... hundreds of manual screening calls' is the site's own wording on /ai-phone-screening.
L4-6: home/about: JusRecruit is an Agentic ATS; AI does phone screening and first-round interviews; 'Recruiters and hiring teams remain responsible for final hiring decisions.'
L7: /ai-phone-screening: AI voice agent that calls every applicant; '24/7'; multiple interview languages.
L8: /ai-phone-screening stat '< 5 min to set up automated screening' (site claim).
L9-11: /ai-interviews and home: Sai and Aina are the AI interviewers; adaptive questions; 'overall candidate score out of 100'; full conversation, transcript and recorded-interview replay.
L12: home: ATS includes job posting, candidate management, documents and offer letters.
L13: /pricing: 'posting unlimited jobs and using the lightweight ATS is free forever'; 14-day free trial of full platform. NOTE: not stating a price; paid plan prices were not read.

Stats on the site (3x faster hiring, 90% satisfaction, 100% bias reduction, 85% manual time saved, 10K+ AI interviews, 92% role fit) are marketing claims with no methodology; deliberately left out of the script. Say if you want any included, attributed as the company's own claims.
Company: product of HTH Technolabs Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru. 'Trusted by 500+ clients' is the site's claim; not used.
